description: Synthetic records of one fictional household (the Arden-Okafor household: Nora, Evan, Eli and Ada) for reproducible acceptance; not a benchmark task. fixtures/reference.json is the package seed, loaded at 2026-11-08 08:00 (America/New_York), with history from 2025-01-01: 213 ingredients, 48 substitution rules, 60 recipes written for this package plus 6 variants, 4 members with 23 dated constraints, 880 plan slots (809 generated from January 2025 to 11 October 2026 and 71 hand-written over the five weeks from 12 October 2026), 40 pantry items with 256 history rows, a shopping list and 74 notifications (60 from generated history, 14 hand-written). fixtures/minimal.json is the smaller household the business tests start from. Both are produced by scripts/build-fixtures.cjs (the earlier history by scripts/history.cjs with a fixed seed) and checked by scripts/check-fixtures.cjs. Workflow shapes (scaling and converting, a meal planner, a pantry, a list built from planned meals) were informed by public help pages of Paprika (https://www.paprikaapp.com/help/v4/ios/), Plan to Eat (https://learn.plantoeat.com/en) and Mealime (https://www.mealime.com/); the nine allergen names follow the FDA's list of major food allergens (https://www.fda.gov/food/nutrition-food-labeling-and-critical-foods/food-allergies). No data, recipe text, photos, branding or icons were taken from them.

sources.description: Hand-authored synthetic records; no external collection. Recipes, steps and the ingredient table were written for this package, and so were the five weeks from 12 October 2026. Nutrition values per 100 g are rounded, illustrative figures, not measurements.

The household's history from 2025-01-01 to 2026-10-11 (weekly menus, cooking, leftovers, guests, other members' plan changes, five earlier constraints, pantry stocking, shops and cooking deductions, and the notifications and activity rows of those events), generated deterministically over the authored recipes and profiles and replayed through the App's own hooks. Every dish passes the App's suitability check for everyone at the table on its date.

transformations: Timestamps carry explicit UTC offsets; household dates are resolved in America/New_York.

The plan history, the variants, the pantry rows, the shopping list and the events (60 generated, 14 hand-written) were produced by replaying them through the App's own hooks at authoring time; rows the account wrote then are marked seed.
Generated notifications take the ID series ntf-h0001 onward so the hand-written ones keep ntf-0001 to ntf-0014; activity rows are numbered in time order.

Generated meals (before 12 October 2026) keep the history row that records how each ended and any change by another member; the account's planning row, which repeats the same dishes and people, is dropped to keep the seed near 1 MB.
fixtures/reference.json and fixtures/minimal.json are written one record per line.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of the realism of recipes, substitution rules and nutrition values, and of the fictional status of the household. The suitability check and nutrition values are simplified and are not medical, allergy or dietary advice.
